probability: Unrounded calibrated positive-class probability in [0,1], null if suppressed; not personal confidence
category_rule: lower: p<=cut1; moderate: cut1<p<=cut2; higher: p>cut2
suppressed_output: probability/category null; no contributing factors; explain eligibility/input limitation
missing_answer_policy: Suppress probability/category/explanation below two supplied model inputs or when cohort eligibility is not confirmed. Otherwise use the actual trained missing handling, retain answer reasons and warn about missingness/distribution shift. This is a project usability guard, not a validated accuracy guarantee.
